Class GameEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.GameEvent
public class GameEvent extends Object
Represents a domain event emitted by the GameState when a significant action (valid or invalid) occurs, requiring notification to observers (e.g., View/Controller).

This class encapsulates what happened and who caused it, allowing decoupled communication within the system.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameEvent

      public GameEvent(GameEvent.Type type, Player culprit)
      Constructs a new broadcastable game event.
      Parameters:
      type - The semantic type of the event. Must not be null.
      culprit - The Player associated with the event. Can be null if the event is not specific to a single player.

    • GameEvent

      public GameEvent(GameEvent.Type type, Player culprit, TriggerKey triggerKey)
      Constructs a game event carrying the trigger key that caused it (e.g. EVENT_CARD_TRIGGERED).
      Parameters:
      type - The semantic type of the event.
      culprit - The player associated with the event, or null.
      triggerKey - The trigger key that originated the event, or null.
